positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Hired as a Software Engineer for the health services company. As a Software Engineer 
developed services for health insurance claims and third-party liability information. 
Developed AWS Lambda and State Machines to error handle API calls. Created templates 
and scripts for security group and IAM role creation with CloudFormation. Packaged and 
deployed services to multiple environments.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
Hired as an IT intern for the managed health services company. Worked as a developer in 
a Web-based team. Tasked with developing APIs using Golang. Assisted in maintaining 
Java code during a Go language migration. Gained experience practicing Scrum 
methodology, keeping track of issues on Jira and documenting efforts and tutorials on 
Confluence.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: My responsibilities include web development of site using  HTML, TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular2, Bootstrap, Git, as tools to create the website the client desires.
